content:
Base inflow per cycle excluding Pipe D:
\[
200+100-50=250\text{ L}
\]

Cycles 1 and 2: Pipe D adds \(75\) L, so net per cycle:
\[
250+75=325\text{ L}
\]
After 2 cycles:
\[
2\cdot 325=650\text{ L},\quad \text{time}=2\cdot 6=12\text{ min}
\]

Remaining:
\[
1000-650=350\text{ L}
\]

Cycle 3: Pipe D rate increases to \(75+25=100\) L/min, so it adds \(100\) L. Net for cycle 3:
\[
250+100=350\text{ L}
\]
This exactly fills the tank by the end of cycle 3.

Cycle time is \(1+2+2+1=6\) minutes.

Total time:
\[
12+6=18\text{ min}
\]

\[
\boxed{18\text{ minutes}}
\]
